{{Top|leg}}
'''Shim-bay crispa''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]]. At a banquet for honored guests of a grand production of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], the criminal known as the [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]] arranged to have [[quella stone]]s baked into the dessert. Several guests, including [[Zanza Gata]], the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] agent leading the Tombat investigation, injured themselves [[Tooth/Legends|biting]] into the dessert.
